content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: About Your First Payment Gateway Record ## slug: about-your-first-payment-gateway-record-2 ## seoTitle: About Your First Payment Gateway Record ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) () Your first Payment Gateway record, named "primary" was created automatically during setup. ::: To view the record, follow the steps below. 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object. * Lightning/Classic: Payments (Admin) App > Payment Gateways Tab 2. Select “All” from the list of List Views. 3. Click the record named "primary." When the {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Default}} field is checked, any {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s created without a related {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} will automatically use the default {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. Only one {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} can be set as the default. The Gateway Information section provides the connection details. If these fields are blank, data in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} will not process in the gateway. You can only get them by clicking the {{variable.Button_PG_ConnecttoGateway}} button.
